title: 27th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/27/3/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the Judicial Service Commission's submission, under Constitution Article 154(b), to remove Judge Al-Ustaz Hussain Faiz Rashad from judicial office is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: a proposal under Rule 272(c) of the Standing Orders to amend Rules 23(l) and 30(a) of the Parliament's Standing Orders is sent to the relevant standing committee.

Unfinished business: debate continues on the resolution submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem noting discrimination between citizens by the judicial branch, to ascertain the views of members of Parliament on the matter.
Environment and Climate Change Committee report on the issue of parties fined for environmental damage and similar offences not paying their fines.
General Committee report (further completed) on the proposal, under Rule 272(c) of the Standing Orders, to amend Chapter 51 of the Parliament's Standing Orders.
Finance Committee report on the bill to amend Law No. 30/2024 (Fiscal Responsibility Act).
Finance Committee report on the bill to amend Law No. 9/2009 (Act on Protection and Privileges for Former Presidents).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting referred a judge-removal case and a Standing Orders amendment to committee, continued debating a resolution on discrimination by the courts, and took up four committee reports on unpaid environmental fines, Standing Orders Chapter 51, the Fiscal Responsibility Act and former presidents' privileges.
